hypothesis: The R21 diagnostic found that draw scores accounted for 17 of its 26 lost top-three hits and none of its 14 newly covered results. Keep the signed R7 draw cells and WDL masses. Test whether R21's reshaping of non-draw scores adds first and top-three hits when allowed only within the home-win and away-win blocks.
data: Reuse the fixed R21 source, inputs and populations. Use only the original R7 prior and the full contextual R21 distribution with the same strictly earlier npxG design and fitted weights. For each draw cell copy the R7 probability. Within home wins and away wins separately, scale every R21 cell by the ratio of the original R7 block mass to the R21 block mass. A zero R21 block inherits the prior block. Both the projected distribution and its mixtures preserve every R7 draw cell and each of its three outcome masses.
selection: Evaluate mixtures of the R7 prior and full projected R21 grid with dose 0, 0.5 and 1. Select one score dose per league from complete 2024/25 validation using first hits, then top-three hits, then exact negative log likelihood, then lower dose. Use the original pre-2024/25 contextual R21 fit for validation and historical tests. Keep the original signed R7 first and ordered three at zero dose, and use R7 WDL and totals decisions at every dose. Also report projection at R21's original score dose and the unprotected contextual fit using R22's chosen dose to distinguish projection from dosage.
evaluation: Use the 2025/26 date-held evaluation, 2026/27 recent and disjoint November extension separately. These populations and the draw failure were seen before this experiment and can inform development only. Verify R7, R21, competition/fixture IDs, order, realized scores, original lines and price fields on the archived comparison rows. Report four distinct metrics, draws and non-draws, paired gains/losses with match-date clustered intervals, plus three-seat sweep and incomplete-batch counts per league. No result is reclassified as a new prospective test.
forward: Use all still-unstarted five-league fixtures in the original R7 source cohort at issue, keep ineligible started fixtures in the coverage count, and bind the earlier R7 and R21 first IDs and original markets. Use the through-extension R21 fit with the same validation dose. Issue one first plus two ordered alternates per fixture; rank three per competition by issued first score probability, then kickoff and stable match ID. Retain actual time and both immutable receipts. Research only; grade first, three selected slots, ordered three, WDL and actual-line non-push FULL_WIN separately.
